newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen in narrow range, awaiting data.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen in narrow range, awaiting data.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to move in a narrow range on Thursday as most investors were waiting for the country's key economic indicators to be released by the central bank later in the day, brokers said.

"The index will probably move in a narrow range in the morning as investors are waiting for economic indicators, especially for foreign reserves. The index has a chance to rise in the afternoon if the figures on foreign reserves look okay," said Thaneit Khantigaroon of Ekachart Finance.
The composite SET index closed 2.63 points lower at 679.53 on 4.9 billion baht turnover on Wednesday.

Economists and analysts have expected the Thai June foreign reserves figures to drop to between $25-$31 billion from $33.3 billion in May after weeks of a currency war waged by the authorities with baht speculators.
The Bank of Thailand is believed to have spent hefty sums of its foreign reserves to defend the baht in May and June before it floated the currency on July 2.
